verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a UI framework, so user-defined automation rules that fire actions on events (workflow-style triggers) fall outside its product category. Its fine-grained reactivity, where code reruns when state changes, is a developer building block for building UIs, not an end-user rule-automation feature, so it does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
